description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementDecorator class, which provides additional behaviors and convenience methods for the LeaveEntitlement entity in the HRM system. It includes methods for calculating available leave days, checking date ranges, and setting related entities via references.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds utility methods and behaviors to the LeaveEntitlement entity, facilitating operations such as date calculations, reference setting, and status checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a LeaveEntitlement object.

methods.name: getAvailableDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of available leave days remaining.

methods.name: withinPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the entitlement period.

methods.name: setEntitlementTypeById
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type for the leave entitlement based on an ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the leave entitlement based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave type for the entitlement based on an ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted credited date, if any.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Determines if the leave entitlement can be deleted.
